CREATE TRIGGER client_session_require_fresh BEFORE UPDATE OF writer_epoch ON client_sessions
		WHEN NEW.writer_epoch > OLD.writer_epoch
		AND NEW.run_id IS NOT NULL
		AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM backup_restore_barriers b WHERE b.project=NEW.project_id AND b.run=NEW.run_id)
		AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects r WHERE r.kind='Run' AND r.project=NEW.project_id AND r.id=NEW.run_id
			AND json_extract(r.body,'$.status') IN ('QUEUED','STARTING','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED','RECONCILING','LOST'))
		AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM runtime_observations o
			WHERE o.project=NEW.project_id AND o.run=NEW.run_id
			AND o.observed_at > (SELECT max(b.restored_at) FROM backup_restore_barriers b WHERE b.project=NEW.project_id AND b.run=NEW.run_id)
			AND json_extract(o.body,'$.children_stopped')=1 AND json_extract(o.body,'$.queue_empty')=1)
		BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'RESTORE_FRESH_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'); END

original_triggers.evolution_release_operation_guard:
CREATE TRIGGER evolution_release_operation_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON evolution_release_operations
WHEN OLD.project IS NOT NEW.project OR OLD.candidate IS NOT NEW.candidate OR OLD.action IS NOT NEW.action OR
     OLD.operation_id IS NOT NEW.operation_id OR OLD.expected_epoch IS NOT NEW.expected_epoch OR
     OLD.admission_hash IS NOT NEW.admission_hash OR OLD.effect_key IS NOT NEW.effect_key OR
     (OLD.receipt_digest IS NOT NULL AND OLD.receipt_digest IS NOT NEW.receipt_digest) OR
     (OLD.status=NEW.status AND (OLD.receipt_digest IS NOT NEW.receipt_digest OR OLD.projection_revision IS NOT NEW.projection_revision)) OR
     (OLD.status!=NEW.status AND NOT (
       (OLD.status='PREPARED' AND NEW.status IN ('DISPATCHED','FAILED')) OR
       (OLD.status='DISPATCHED' AND NEW.status='OBSERVED') OR
       (OLD.status='OBSERVED' AND NEW.status='PROJECTED')))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'release operation is immutable or transition invalid'); END

CREATE TRIGGER research_monitor_cycle_insert BEFORE INSERT ON research_monitor_cycles BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM research_monitor_cycles WHERE project=NEW.project AND cycle=NEW.cycle)
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'monitor cycle cannot be replaced') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects WHERE project=NEW.project AND kind='ResearchCycle' AND id=NEW.cycle)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects WHERE project=NEW.project AND kind='Goal' AND id=NEW.goal)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM intent_plan_bindings WHERE project=NEW.project AND compiled_goal=NEW.goal AND plan_kind='MONITOR' AND monitor_current=1 AND accepted_revision IS NOT NULL AND acceptance_ref IS NOT NULL AND brief_ref=NEW.plan_ref)
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'monitor cycle needs accepted same-project plan') END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER research_review_bound_insert BEFORE INSERT ON research_candidate_reviews
WHEN NEW.reviewer_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.review_task_ref IS NOT NULL OR NEW.acceptance_ref IS NOT NULL BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.reviewer_id IS NULL OR NEW.review_task_ref IS NULL OR NEW.acceptance_ref IS NULL
 OR NOT json_valid(NEW.review_task_ref) OR NOT json_valid(NEW.acceptance_ref)
 OR json_type(NEW.review_task_ref,'$.revision') IS NOT 'integer'
 OR json_type(NEW.acceptance_ref,'$.revision') IS NOT 'integer'
 OR json_extract(NEW.review_task_ref,'$.entity_type') IS NOT 'Task'
 OR json_extract(NEW.acceptance_ref,'$.entity_type') IS NOT 'AcceptanceReceipt'
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM research_cycle_work w WHERE w.project=NEW.project AND w.cycle=NEW.cycle_id AND w.stage='review' AND w.evidence_id=NEW.evidence_id AND w.task=json_extract(NEW.review_task_ref,'$.id'))
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects WHERE project=NEW.project AND kind='AcceptanceReceipt' AND id=json_extract(NEW.acceptance_ref,'$.id') AND json_extract(body,'$.verifier_principal_id')=NEW.reviewer_id)
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'bound current review required') END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER research_work_update BEFORE UPDATE ON research_cycle_work BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.project IS NOT OLD.project OR NEW.cycle IS NOT OLD.cycle OR NEW.logical_key IS NOT OLD.logical_key OR NEW.plan_ref IS NOT OLD.plan_ref OR NEW.stage IS NOT OLD.stage OR NEW.task IS NOT OLD.task OR NEW.experiment IS NOT OLD.experiment OR NEW.source_id IS NOT OLD.source_id OR NEW.evidence_id IS NOT OLD.evidence_id OR NEW.input_refs IS NOT OLD.input_refs OR NEW.input_hash IS NOT OLD.input_hash OR NEW.parameters IS NOT OLD.parameters OR NEW.window_from IS NOT OLD.window_from OR NEW.window_to IS NOT OLD.window_to OR NEW.progress_record_id IS NOT OLD.progress_record_id OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'immutable research work mapping') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN OLD.source_receipt IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_receipt IS NOT OLD.source_receipt
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'immutable source receipt') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.source_receipt IS NOT NULL AND (
 json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.epoch') IS NOT 'integer' OR json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.epoch')<1
 OR json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.project_id') IS NOT NEW.project
 OR json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.task_id') IS NOT NEW.task
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.effect_key') IS NOT 'text'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.request_hash') IS NOT 'text'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.reservation_id') IS NOT 'text'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.manifest_ref') IS NOT 'object'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.cursor_before_ref') IS NOT 'object'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.cursor_after_ref') IS NOT 'object'
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects WHERE project=NEW.project AND kind='Run' AND id=json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.run_id') AND json_extract(body,'$.task_id')=NEW.task)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects WHERE project=NEW.project AND kind='BudgetLedgerEntry' AND id=json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.reservation_id')))
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'bound source receipt required') END;
END

triggers_after.evolution_release_operation_guard:
CREATE TRIGGER evolution_release_operation_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON evolution_release_operations
WHEN OLD.project IS NOT NEW.project OR OLD.candidate IS NOT NEW.candidate OR OLD.action IS NOT NEW.action OR
     OLD.operation_id IS NOT NEW.operation_id OR OLD.expected_epoch IS NOT NEW.expected_epoch OR
     OLD.admission_hash IS NOT NEW.admission_hash OR OLD.effect_key IS NOT NEW.effect_key OR
     (OLD.receipt_digest IS NOT NULL AND OLD.receipt_digest IS NOT NEW.receipt_digest) OR
     (OLD.status=NEW.status AND (OLD.receipt_digest IS NOT NEW.receipt_digest OR OLD.projection_revision IS NOT NEW.projection_revision)) OR
     (OLD.status!=NEW.status AND NOT (
       (OLD.status='PREPARED' AND NEW.status IN ('DISPATCHED','FAILED')) OR
       (OLD.status='DISPATCHED' AND NEW.status='OBSERVED') OR
       (OLD.status='OBSERVED' AND NEW.status='PROJECTED')))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'release operation is immutable or transition invalid'); END

CREATE TRIGGER evolution_release_operation_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON evolution_release_operations
WHEN NEW.status!='PREPARED' OR
     EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM evolution_release_operations WHERE project=NEW.project AND candidate=NEW.candidate AND action=NEW.action) OR
     EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM evolution_release_operations WHERE operation_id=NEW.operation_id) OR
     EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM evolution_release_operations WHERE effect_key=NEW.effect_key)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'release operation must begin prepared and cannot replace identity'); END

triggers_after.research_monitor_cycle_insert:
CREATE TRIGGER research_monitor_cycle_insert BEFORE INSERT ON research_monitor_cycles BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM research_monitor_cycles WHERE project=NEW.project AND cycle=NEW.cycle)
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'monitor cycle cannot be replaced') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects WHERE project=NEW.project AND kind='ResearchCycle' AND id=NEW.cycle)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects WHERE project=NEW.project AND kind='Goal' AND id=NEW.goal)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM intent_plan_bindings WHERE project=NEW.project AND compiled_goal=NEW.goal AND plan_kind='MONITOR' AND monitor_current=1 AND accepted_revision IS NOT NULL AND acceptance_ref IS NOT NULL AND brief_ref=NEW.plan_ref)
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'monitor cycle needs accepted same-project plan') END;
END

triggers_after.research_review_bound_insert:
CREATE TRIGGER research_review_bound_insert BEFORE INSERT ON research_candidate_reviews
WHEN NEW.reviewer_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.review_task_ref IS NOT NULL OR NEW.acceptance_ref IS NOT NULL BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.reviewer_id IS NULL OR NEW.review_task_ref IS NULL OR NEW.acceptance_ref IS NULL
 OR NOT json_valid(NEW.review_task_ref) OR NOT json_valid(NEW.acceptance_ref)
 OR json_type(NEW.review_task_ref,'$.revision') IS NOT 'integer'
 OR json_type(NEW.acceptance_ref,'$.revision') IS NOT 'integer'
 OR json_extract(NEW.review_task_ref,'$.entity_type') IS NOT 'Task'
 OR json_extract(NEW.acceptance_ref,'$.entity_type') IS NOT 'AcceptanceReceipt'
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM research_cycle_work w WHERE w.project=NEW.project AND w.cycle=NEW.cycle_id AND w.stage='review' AND w.evidence_id=NEW.evidence_id AND w.task=json_extract(NEW.review_task_ref,'$.id'))
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects WHERE project=NEW.project AND kind='AcceptanceReceipt' AND id=json_extract(NEW.acceptance_ref,'$.id') AND json_extract(body,'$.verifier_principal_id')=NEW.reviewer_id)
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'bound current review required') END;
END

triggers_after.research_work_update:
CREATE TRIGGER research_work_update BEFORE UPDATE ON research_cycle_work BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.project IS NOT OLD.project OR NEW.cycle IS NOT OLD.cycle OR NEW.logical_key IS NOT OLD.logical_key OR NEW.plan_ref IS NOT OLD.plan_ref OR NEW.stage IS NOT OLD.stage OR NEW.task IS NOT OLD.task OR NEW.experiment IS NOT OLD.experiment OR NEW.source_id IS NOT OLD.source_id OR NEW.evidence_id IS NOT OLD.evidence_id OR NEW.input_refs IS NOT OLD.input_refs OR NEW.input_hash IS NOT OLD.input_hash OR NEW.parameters IS NOT OLD.parameters OR NEW.window_from IS NOT OLD.window_from OR NEW.window_to IS NOT OLD.window_to OR NEW.progress_record_id IS NOT OLD.progress_record_id OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'immutable research work mapping') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN OLD.source_receipt IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_receipt IS NOT OLD.source_receipt
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'immutable source receipt') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.source_receipt IS NOT NULL AND (
 json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.epoch') IS NOT 'integer' OR json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.epoch')<1
 OR json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.project_id') IS NOT NEW.project
 OR json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.task_id') IS NOT NEW.task
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.effect_key') IS NOT 'text'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.request_hash') IS NOT 'text'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.reservation_id') IS NOT 'text'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.manifest_ref') IS NOT 'object'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.cursor_before_ref') IS NOT 'object'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.cursor_after_ref') IS NOT 'object'
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects WHERE project=NEW.project AND kind='Run' AND id=json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.run_id') AND json_extract(body,'$.task_id')=NEW.task)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects WHERE project=NEW.project AND kind='BudgetLedgerEntry' AND id=json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.reservation_id')))
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'bound source receipt required') END;
END
